Name: Wombat Pet
Author: Alexilyn
Description:
[font=Courier New]It was a rather strange idea to make a wombat, but how can you not love these cute furry animals? They are adorable!
Yes, it may be a little strange to hear a wombat bark or meow, but I think it can be got used to.
Still, instead of wagging his tail, he just digs, the tail is small, deal with it. And cat version digs too.
Also in winter, he can wear his scarf to keep warm, which is very cute.

[color=#d5a6bd][size=3][b]˗ˏˋConfigurationsˎˊ˗[/b][/size][/color]
   In config file you can choose which dog or cat to replace with a wombat.
[list]
[*][b]Options:[/b]  [color=#d5a6bd]dog, dog1, dog2, cat, cat1, cat2[/color] (By default it replace all of the pets, but you can just choose multiple pets to replace or just left it blank, if you decided to switch off the mod)
[*][b]Scarf:[/b] [color=#d5a6bd]enable, disable[/color]
[/list][/font]
